mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CART ( QUANTITY, CART_TYPE, CREATED_AT, USER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, OPTION_ITEM_ID, RENTAL_START, RENTAL_END ) VALUES ( #{quantity}, #{cartType}, NOW(), #{userId}, #{productId}, #{optionItemId}, NULLIF(#{rentalStart}, ''), NULLIF(#{rentalEnd}, '') )
mapper.select:
SELECT CART_ID AS cartId, QUANTITY AS quantity FROM CART WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} AND CART_TYPE = #{cartType} AND IFNULL(OPTION_ITEM_ID, 0) = IFNULL(#{optionItemId}, 0)
AND IFNULL(RENTAL_START, '1000-01-01') = IFNULL(NULLIF(#{rentalStart}, ''), '1000-01-01') AND IFNULL(RENTAL_END, '1000-01-01') = IFNULL(NULLIF(#{rentalEnd}, ''), '1000-01-01')
LIMIT 1

SELECT c.CART_ID AS cartId, c.QUANTITY AS quantity, c.CART_TYPE AS cartType, c.USER_ID AS userId, c.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, c.OPTION_ITEM_ID AS optionItemId, c.RENTAL_START AS rentalStart, c.RENTAL_END AS rentalEnd,
p.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, p.PRICE AS price, p.DEPOSIT AS deposit,
b.BRAND_NAME AS brandName, i.IMG_URL AS imgUrl,
poi.ITEM_NAME AS optionName, poi.EXTRA_PRICE AS extraPrice, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(poiv.OPTION_VALUE_ID ORDER BY poiv.OPTION_VALUE_ID) FROM PRODUCT_OPTION_ITEM_VALUE poiv WHERE poiv.OPTION_ITEM_ID = c.OPTION_ITEM_ID ) AS optionValueIds, (p.PRICE + IFNULL(poi.EXTRA_PRICE, 0)) AS unitPrice
FROM CART c INNER JOIN PRODUCT p ON c.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID LEFT JOIN BRAND b ON p.BRAND_ID = b.BRAND_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_IMG i ON p.PRODUCT_ID = i.PRODUCT_ID AND i.IS_MAIN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_OPTION_ITEM poi ON c.OPTION_ITEM_ID = poi.OPTION_ITEM_ID WHERE c.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY c.CREATED_AT DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE CART SET QUANTITY = #{quantity}, OPTION_ITEM_ID = #{optionItemId}, RENTAL_START = NULLIF(#{rentalStart}, ''), RENTAL_END = NULLIF(#{rentalEnd}, '') WHERE CART_ID = #{cartId} AND USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT CART_ID AS cartId, QUANTITY AS quantity, CART_TYPE AS cartType, PRODUCT_ID AS productId, OPTION_ITEM_ID AS optionItemId, RENTAL_START AS rentalStart, RENTAL_END AS rentalEnd FROM CART WHERE CART_ID = #{cartId} AND USER_ID = #{userId}
